scripts.build: npm run prepare:icon && npm run build:runtime && npm run build:renderer && node tools/copy-runtime-resources.cjs
scripts.build:reference: npm run prepare:icon && npm run build:runtime && npm run build:renderer && node tools/build-project-resources.cjs --project ./reference/asset-operations/project.json --output ./dist/resources
scripts.build:reference:release: npm run prepare:icon && npm run build:runtime && npm run build:renderer && node tools/build-project-resources.cjs --project ./reference/asset-operations/project.json --output ./dist/resources --require-external-digests
scripts.dist:win: node tools/clean-installers.cjs && npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64
scripts.dist:win:reference: node tools/clean-installers.cjs && npm run build:reference:release && electron-builder --config electron-builder.reference.yml --win nsis --x64
